integrity: The proof is analytic: for finite p != 2 a one-parameter two-coordinate family crosses a Pythagorean denominator zero while its numerator stays nonzero with the same sign on the appropriate side; p=infinity is explicit and p=2 follows from the parallelogram identity. The bundled checker numerically reproduces the sign crossings and blow-up on representative exponents but is not used as proof of the universal quantifiers. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies the Zhou–Ni–Liu–Li quotient only on real ell_p sequence spaces with at least two coordinates. It does not assert the same classification for arbitrary L_p spaces or general uniformly convex Banach spaces. For p != 2 the result is unboundedness of the defining supremum, not attainment of an infinite value by a pair.
title: Finiteness dichotomy for \(P(X)\) on real \(\ell_p\) spaces
